item.title: Volunteers’ Roles Must Be Recognized in the Humanitarian Reset
item.description: The humanitarian system cannot keep planning as if volunteers do not exist. That sounds absurd. Yet it is exactly what we do. Every major crisis tells the same story. item.title: Yemen: Türk alarmed by rising civilian toll, urges restraint
item.description: Escalating conflict in Yemen is killing and injuring a growing number of civilians, the UN human rights chief warned on Monday, as Houthi rebels also strike Saudi Arabia and Red Sea shipping linked to the wider Iran–US confrontation.
